Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this game! Scotland have gone through while UAE bow out. We have another match coming up as Hong Kong face Oman in Dubai at 1930 local (1530 GMT).

Scotland skipper, Kyle Coetzer, says he is over the moon at the moment, they spoke about this, they had one chance and they wanted to take it. Further adds they were at the losing end in Zimbabwe for the 50-over World Cup Qualifiers and they are on the other side this time. Ends by saying they have a lot of fine players and they want to keep improving and keep learning.
UAE skipper, Ahmed Raza, says it is difficult to swallow but congratulates the Scotland side. Further adds he is proud of how the team fared and is very happy they made it till here.

MAN OF THE MATCH, George Munsey, says he wanted to take the attack right from the outset and it worked. Further adds it is exciting times now, it has not gone their way throughout but it is pleasing to get over the line. Ends by saying the credit has to be given to the whole staff, the coaches and all the players.
Stay tuned for the presentation.

There is nothing to talk about the hosts though, their bowling was poor giving away easy runs and allowing the Scots to reach a huge score on this wicket. Their batting was worse as they lost wickets in a heap and did not get even close to their target. They will be disappointed with this performance and with this loss, UAE are out of contention for a spot in the ICC T20 World Cup.

The Scots bowling was even better as they bowled out the hosts for a cheap score and gained qualification for the ICC T20 World Cup in Australia. They made good use of their slower balls and made the batsmen dance to their tunes.

Scotland did not give the hosts a chance. It all started with the partnership between Kyle Coetzer and George Munsey stitching a partnership of 87 before Coetzer was holed out. Things went further south when George Munsey fell as Richie Berrington came out and played a blistering innings of 48 off just 18 balls helping them reach a total of 198 runs.
A thumping victory for Scotland sees them qualify for the ICC T20 World Cup in Australia! All smiles in their camp and their few supporters in the stadium are up on their feet applauding the effort.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is the end of it! Scotland can now celebrate! Short ball on middle, Zahoor looks to pull it but he gets a top edge which goes way up in the air. Sharif settles under it and takes a simple catch near the stumps at the bowler's end. SCOTLAND WIN BY 90 RUNS.
Full delivery on middle, Zahoor Khan looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. No run.
Good length ball outside off, D'Silva pushes it towards the point region and takes off for a single.
Play and a miss! On a good length and outside off, Khan looks to swing at it but misses it.
On a good length on off, D'Silva plays it towards point. The batsmen take a run.
Full delivery on off, Khan lofts it over mid off for a run.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. Full delivery on off, Khan lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Full delivery on middle, D'Silva flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot. Full delivery on off, D'Silva lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Josh Davey is back on. 2-0-12-1 are his figures so far.
Full delivery on middle, D'Silva flicks it towards the leg side for a single.

DROPPED! Leask after taking a catch drops this one! Good length ball on middle, Khan looks to loft this one over mid off but does not get the required elevation on it. It goes way up in the air and Michael Leask runs back to take the catch but fails to hold onto it.
Short ball on middle, Zahoor looks to hook it but fails to put any bat on it.
Full delivery on middle, Khan pushes it towards the mid on region for nothing.
Zahoor Khan is the last man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Scotland just one wicket away from qualifying for the ICC T20 World Cup in Australia. Good length ball on off, Ahmed Raza pushes at it and it goes uppishly towards mid off. Michael Leask dives forward and takes the catch.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! Good length ball on middle, D'Silva defends it off the front foot towards the cover region and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the stumps at the keeper's end and hits. The ball deflects and goes into the square leg fence for a boundary.
Safyaan Sharif is back on. 2-0-13-1 are his figures so far.
Good length ball outside off, Raza looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Darius D'Silva is back to resume his innings. He is fine and all set to continue.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gets a bat on this one but finds the deep mid-wicket fielder. Short ball on middle, Junaid looks to pull this one but it goes off the top half of his bat towards deep mid-wicket. Michael Leask settles under it and takes a simple catch.
Short ball on off, Junaid looks to pull it but misses.
Short delivery outside off, Siddique attempts to pull it but fails to make any connection to it.
Another short delivery around off, Junaid looks to pull it again but fails to put any bat on it.
Short ball on the off stump line, Siddique looks to pull it towards fine leg but fails to put any bat on it.
Alasdair Evans is back on. 3-0-18-0 are his figures so far.
Flatter delivery outside off, Junaid punches this off the back foot towards the off side for a single.
BEATEN! Flighted delivery outside off, Junaid looks to loft this one but fails to connect with it. The keeper appeals for a stumping but nothing from the umpire.
Flatter delivery in middle, Junaid drives it to the bowler.
Flighted ball on off, Raza comes down the track and drives it to long off for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Ahmed drives it back to the bowler.
Full delivery on middle, Siddique flicks it to long on and takes a single.
Around off, Raza defends it out.
Short around off, blocked towards off side for a single.
On middle, pushed towards mid-wicket for an easy run this time.
Around off, Raza looks to turn it around the leg side but gets leading edge towards cover.
Outside off, guided it towards point.
Junaid Siddique is the new batsman in.
OUT! Another one bites the dust. This is going to end too early it seems. A flighted ball on middle, Boota flicks but finds Munsey at deep square leg. UAE falling like nine pins.
Calum MacLeod is back on. 2-0-16-0 are his figures so far.
Shortish length ball this time, Boota taps it towards point off the back foot.
On middle and leg, Raza eases for a single towards mid on.
Ahmed Raza is the next batsman in.
OUT! Timber! First ball duck for Sultan Ahmed. Watt fires it on off on a slightly shortish length, Ahmed looks to cut but misses. What happens next, the timber behind is knocked out.
On the pads, tucked behind square leg for a single.
Sultan Ahmed is the new batsman in.

OUT! Wicket number five and UAE are falling apart. A full ball on middle, Usman dances down the track to hammer it over the long on fence but again no proper connection. He gets more height than distance. The fielder from long on comes haring at the ball and pouches it sliding forward.
Full, Usman comes down the track to drive but gets it back to the bowler off the inner half of the bat.
Mohammad Boota is the next batsman in. Mark Watt is back into the attack. 2-0-15-1 are his figures so far.

OUT! This time short ball gets Berrington a wicket. Short and on middle, Ahmed looks to pull but fails to make proper connection. It goes straight to the short fine leg fielder where Josh Davey pouches it with ease.
Another short ball, pulled for a single this time.
Landed short on middle, Waheed looks to power it over the long on fence but mistimes it. The ball lands short of the fielder again.
Another mistimed shot but lands short of the fielder. Short ball around middle, Usman looks to pull but another mistimed shot falls short of the fielder. A single.
Slower bouncer! Waheed looks to pull but misses as he plays it too early. The ball hits his shoulder and goes towards point. A quick leg bye taken.
On middle, Usman drives it past the bowler for a single as it goes towards long off.
Richie Berrington is into the attack.
Good length ball on middle, Usman flicks it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Short ball on middle, Usman pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
WIDE! Bouncer aimed at the body, Usman lets it go. It is wided.
On a length on middle, Muhammad flicks it towards the fine leg region and takes a couple.
Good length ball on middle, Waheed looks to flick it but  gets hit on the pads. The players put in an appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The batters take a leg bye.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Ahmed looks to cut it but fails to put any bat on it.
Short delivery on middle, Muhammad pulls it towards the deep square leg region and takes a single. The fielder runs around and cleans it up.
Alasdair Evans is back on. 2-0-9-0 are his figures so far.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Waheed comes down the track and looks to drive it but it goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg. The batters cross for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Usman punches it off the back foot towards the off side for a single.
Quicker delivery on middle, Waheed pulls it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Usman flicks it towards the deep mid-wicket region and crosses over for a single.
Bowls a flatter delivery on middle, Waheed flicks it towards the square leg region for a single.
Another single. Fuller and outside off, Ahmed drives it through covers for a run.
Full again, Usman eases this through for a single this time.
On middle, pushed for a single towards mid on.
Full outside off, pushed towards mid off. So a dot off the Free Hit.
NO BALL! Called no ball for height. A rank hop on the pads, Usman can only pick up a single through mid-wicket. Free  Hit coming up.
Waheed Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! Shahzad's struggle is over. Watt has a wicket now. Flighted ball around off, Shahzad goes away to carve it over the cover region but can only manage to lob it high in the air off the sliced shot. Munsey at deep cover gobbles it safely.

SIX! But what an effort from Tom Sole. It looked as if he had saved the six but not really.  A fuller length ball on middle, Shahzad goes for the slog and connects it well. Tom Sole at deep mid-wicket goes back, takes the catch but the momentum takes him towards the fence. He looks to throw the ball back in play but as he does that, the ball hits the boundary rope.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full outside off, Shahzad drives it through covers and pick a couple.
Just misses the timber. MacLeod fires this on middle, Shahzad looks to cut but fails to get any bat on the ball. Goes just over the stumps.
Outside off, pushed towards third man.
FOUR! Full ball on the pads, Rameez flicks it through fine leg and gets a boundary.
Short and outside off, Usman reaches out and slices the ball over the point fielder. Three runs taken.
Calum MacLeod is into the attack.
On middle, Shahzad blocks it out. Just 4 runs from the over.
On the pads this time, Shahzad flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Shortish length ball this time, punched towards point for a single.
Fuller ball this time, eases it through mid on for a single.
Fullish length ball down the leg side. Shahzad looks to flick it but misses to get hit on the body.
Around off, Shahzad pushes it back to the bowler.
Darius D'Silva is looking in real pain and is going back to the pavilion. Muhammad Usman replaces him. Mark Watt is into the attack.
On the pads, driven towards mid on for a single.

Dropped! Another ball outside off, Shahzad looks to cut again but can't make the proper connection. The ball goes high towards cover-point where the fielder goes for the catch but fails to hold on to it. The batsmen get two runs.
SIX! Up and over this time. Short and outside off, Shahzad this time throws the bat at ball. Gets the timing right this time and slashes the ball over the third man fence.

Just short! Length ball on middle, Shahzad looks to turn it behind square leg but the ball takes the leading edge and goes towards point. The fielder there comes forward to take the catch but the ball falls just short.
Full ball outside off this time, Shahzad reaches out to drive but the ball takes the bottom edge and goes to the keeper on the bounce.

Lands in no man's land there. Shortish length ball outside off, D'Silva looks to pull but gets a top edge. The ball goes high in the air but lands in no man's land at mid on. Two fielders try to get to the ball but they can't get there.
Darius D'Silva is looking in pain as he got hit flush on the knee. He has called for the physio out there. Darius seems fine to continue though.
Outside off, D'Silva looks to scoop it over the fine leg region but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but nothing from the umpire.
Outside off, D'Silva keeps it out.

Munsey saves at least a couple. A shortish length ball on middle, D'Silva pulls it towards deep square leg and scampers back for the second. It would've been a boundary but Munsey chases the ball and keeps it in play.
Outside off, Shahzad guides it towards third man for a single.
Around off, pushed towards cover for a quick single.
On middle, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
Safyaan Sharif comes back into the attack. 1-0-9-1 are his figures so far.
On middle, D'Silva nudges this behind square leg for a single.
Full outside off, D'Silva drives it firmly but straight to the cover fielder.
Around off, D'Silva looks to drive this through the covers but gets an inside edge onto the shoes. The ball goes towards point.
Shortish length ball on middle, Shahzad pulls and takes a run as the ball goes towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Superb off drive this time. Length ball around off, Shahzad drives this ball uppishly through mid off. The ball races to the fence in a jiffy.
Length ball around off, Shahzad looks to drive but can't connect properly.
Length ball on middle, Shahzad works it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike for next over.
Shortish length ball on middle, D'Silva hops and turns the ball towards short fine leg and takes a quick run.
Outside off, D'Silva pushes it towards point.
Good nut that one. Landed around off, and jags back in sharply. D'Silva looks to work it towards the leg side but gets hit on the pads.
Around off, D'Silva defends it out.
Darius D'Silva comes out to the middle.

OUT! Caught! Davey strikes first ball. A fullish length ball outside off, Rohan skips down the track and has a wild swing at the ball. It catches the outside edge and goes behind. Cross is not going to miss out, he grabs it and celebrates. A big wicket this one.
Josh Davey is into the attack.
Third one now! Outside off this time, Shahzad again shoulders arms.
Left alone! Twice in the over. We don't see these this often. A length delivery on middle, Shahzad leaves it alone by dropping his wrists.
On off, Mustafa pushes it towards point and calls for a quick single. The point fielder gets to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Length ball angled into the batter, Shahzad blocks it towards the leg side for a quick single.
Good length ball outside off this time, Shahzad leaves it alone.
Wide now! This time Evans gets his line wrong and sprays it down the leg side. Shahzad flicks but misses. Wide called by the umpire.

Huge appeal but not out says the umpire. What a ball to begin the spell from Evans. A shortish length ball in the channel outside off, Shahzad looks to push it towards the off side but the ball shapes away a hint and beats the outside edge.
Alasdair Evans will bowl from the other end.
Landed on off, Rohan comes forward to defend it out. 9 runs and a wicket.
Length on the pads, Shahzad tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Full ball outside off, Rohan this time pierces the gap between cover and point. The ball races to the deep cover fence but the fielder chases it down and saves a run.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Mustafa looks to flick but misses.
Rameez Shahzad is the new man in.

OUT! Scotland draw first blood. And it is Chirag Suri who departs. A poor shot and the start of the run chase is not how the hosts wanted it. Length ball on middle, Chirag looks to turn the ball towards the leg side but the ball goes high off the top edge towards short fine leg. The wicketkeeper goes after it and pouches it safely.
Top edge and Four! A shortish length ball outside off, Suri this time looks to pull but the ball takes the top edge and the ball goes to the third man fence. Lucky runs.
What was that? Suri is giving the pacer a charge on the very first ball. Length ball around off, Suri comes down the track to play a drive through mid off but misses.
We are back for the chase! Rohan Mustafa and Chirag Suri make their way out to the middle. The Scottish players are also out in the middle to defend 198. Safyaan Sharif will start for Scotland.
